# pm-facing_alias: # Schema: PM-facing alias, wire-format model id, reasoning effort.
# This file is the grok adapter alias table.
# Columns must be tab-separated.
# Executor-agnostic alias — use in briefs, PM routing, and dispatch policy docs:
#   `light`  — lightweight/fast model for targeted changes. Mapped per executor;
#              for grok this is the same product model at lower reasoning effort.
#   `default` — balanced default for routine implementation work.
# Default model: pm-dispatch pins its OWN default (the `default` alias →
# grok-4.5), decoupled from whatever the local grok CLI may default to.
# Precedence: --model flag > PM_CFG_DEFAULT_MODEL > built-in `default` alias.
# Override per-host via ~/.pm-dispatch/config `dispatch.default_model`.
# Wire IDs accepted by the Grok Build CLI (product names may evolve):
#   grok-4.5       — current default Grok 4.5 product id
#   grok-build     — Grok Build product alias
#   grok-4.5-build — usage/telemetry key observed on streaming-json end events
# reasoning_effort column values feed runtime/lib/reasoning-effort.sh when the
# --effort flag is absent. Valid intersection with pm-dispatch is low|medium|high
# (non-matching values fall through to the global medium default).
default
light
build
grok-build
grok-4.5
grok-4.5-build
